hypotheses.claim: Because the 6-solver portfolio is saturated (SBS 15.7435 vs VBS gap only 0.44%) and all weakest regimes are the same instances (clustered spatial, eccentric depot, n=100, uniform demand, tight capacity), marginal gains must come from removing spatially-related node clusters rather than top-cost singletons: a score_ruin_nodes hook that blends normalized removal savings with a Shaw-style relatedness term (mean distance to the route's nearest neighbors in the destroyed seed set) plus a demand-fill gate that prefers removing customers whose demand amplitude ~ capacity fill, and that multiplicatively widens q / flattens the rank power as stagnation_ratio and iter_frac grow, will reduce mean objective on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 below the current 15.7435 within the 500 ms budget while preserving deterministic first_feasible behavior.

next_search_advice.direction: Diversify the ruin node-scoring hook away from pure worst-removal toward cluster-aware (Shaw-relatedness) removal with tight-capacity demand gating and stagnation-scaled diversification, targeting the clustered / eccentric-depot / tight-capacity / size-100 weak regimes.
